sections.name: DEFAULT_BUCKETS
sections.title: Four default job groups
sections.what: The four starting groups: AI Product, MBB Strategy, Big Tech Strategy and Emerging AI. Each has its matching rules, excluded titles, preferred sectors, places, keywords, companies, seniority and weight.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives sorting a sensible starting point before the user customizes it.
sections.watch_out: Changing these values changes how every job is sorted across the app.

summary: Holds the four default job groups (buckets) with the title words, keywords, companies, seniority levels and weights the app uses to sort jobs.
purpose: Gives the app a starting set of job categories before the user customizes anything.
why: The header says this list is a shared copy for now and will later load from a configuration file.
how: Keeps one fixed list. Each bucket describes which titles to match, which to exclude, preferred sectors, places, required keywords, boosting keywords, target companies, seniority and a weight.
outputs: A list of TargetBucket records used by other code.
risks: The four weights add up to 1.0, so changing one without the others changes the balance. Changing a bucket ID may break applications that refer to it. The AI product and emerging AI buckets overlap, so some jobs may fit either.
debug: If jobs land in the wrong bucket, check the title and keyword lists in this file. The packet does not show whether another part of the app keeps its own copy.
